extracted.description: For each US state, determine the number of distinct NIFC Geographic Areas that the state falls into.
States must be identified using full official US state names, not abbreviations or codes.
Only NIFC Geographic Areas count toward the measurement; other area or region definitions must be excluded.
Identify the state(s) with the highest number of NIFC Geographic Areas among all US states.
Verify maximality by confirming that removing the reported state(s) leaves no other state with the same top count unless it is also reported.

stored.description: For each US state, determine the number of distinct NIFC Geographic Areas that the state falls into.
acceptanceCriteria: Each state has a computed count of NIFC Geographic Areas it belongs to
The count is over distinct Geographic Areas, so a state is counted at most once per Geographic Area
